description: This Java source file defines the AndroidIdlCompiler class, which implements source code generation for Android Interface Definition Language (AIDL) files within the IntelliJ IDEA/JetBrains plugin environment. It manages compilation, validation, and refresh of generated Java files from AIDL sources, including handling module and project scope, and integrates with Android SDK tools.

classes.name: AndroidIdlCompiler
classes.description: Implements source code generation and compilation for Android AIDL files within the IntelliJ plugin environment.

classes.name: IdlGenerationItem
classes.description: Represents a generated Java file from an AIDL source, including module, file, package, and validity state.

methods.name: getPresentableFile
methods.description: Returns null; placeholder for presenting generated files.

methods.name: getGenerationItems
methods.description: Prepares and returns a list of AIDL files to generate Java code from.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Performs the code generation for AIDL files, updating the project with generated Java sources.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the compiler, based on AIDL filename.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Always returns true; validates the compilation scope.

methods.name: createValidityState
methods.description: Creates a validity state object based on file timestamp.
